entities.name: Murgaxor Grenshel
entities.description: Burrog former Witherbloom student expelled for lethal life-draining magic who plotted to drain Strixhaven's population for immortality.

entities.name: Strixhaven University
entities.description: University where Murgaxor studied and which he targeted.

entities.name: Witherbloom College
entities.description: College from which Murgaxor was expelled.

entities.name: Augusta Tullus
entities.description: Dean of Lorehold corrupted by Murgaxor.

entities.name: Y'demi
entities.description: Bloodmage left behind to deal with would-be heroes.

entities.name: Khelvor
entities.description: Daemogoth set to guard the stronghold.

entities.name: Ruins of Caerdoon
entities.description: Murgaxor's lair where his ritual was disrupted.

entities.name: Fortress Badlands
entities.description: Region where his acolytes established a foothold.

events.summary: Murgaxor is expelled after a student dies in his illicit activities, and flees.
Murgaxor corrupts Dean Tullus to spread tainted materials across campus for a vast ritual.
events.quote: corrupting Dean Augusta Tullus of Lorehold

events.summary: His operations are uncovered, severing his control over Tullus; he moves to the Ruins of Caerdoon.
events.quote: He moved his lair to the Ruins of Caerdoon

events.summary: Murgaxor is confronted and his ritual disrupted; he reverts to a weakened burrog.
events.quote: he reverted to a weakened burrog form with no remaining magical capabilities

relations.quote: compelling her to distribute magically tainted materials across campus
He also set up the daemogoth Khelvor to guard the stronghold
